children: BankrCoin has announced that BNKR staking goes live on bankr.bot and through the agent within 72 hours. A staking window opens first for all holders, and once it opens, rewards begin streaming to participants. The reward source is protocol revenue: 30% of protocol fees are directed to stakers, tying staking returns directly to usage of the Bankr platform rather than to fixed emissions.

The fee-share design gives BNKR a direct value-accrual path. Staking returns scale with protocol activity, so token holders now have a reason to lock supply and track platform usage as the driver of yield. Lockup from staking also reduces circulating supply available for trading.
The initial staking window is the practical entry point. Holders who want exposure to the fee stream need to stake once the window opens, since rewards begin streaming after that step.
once this goes live there will be a window for everyone to stake and then after that period rewards will begin streaming.

title: BankrCoin: BNKR staking goes live with 30% of protocol fees routed to stakers - By 27 Sep 2026
